
    <section id="inventory" class="section inventory-section">
      <div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">LIFE CYCLE INVENTORY</p><h2>Reuse shifts the burden into activation energy.</h2></div><p class="section-note">The approved carousel reports the total activation electricity and impact sub-flows. It does not disclose the detailed material masses, so no material bill of quantities is invented here.</p></div>
      <div class="inventory-table-wrap"><table class="inventory-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Stage</th><th>Component / activity</th><th>Activity data</th><th>Climate change</th><th>Modelling basis</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Operation</td><td>Activation electricity</td><td>621.0 kWh / activation</td><td>114.48 kg CO₂e</td><td>DEFRA 2026 composite electricity = generation 0.13096 + T&amp;D 0.01299 + WTT generation 0.03682 + WTT T&amp;D 0.00359 kg CO₂e/kWh. Sub-flow impacts: optical corridor 36.87; red fire-guard 73.74; control + cooling 3.69; allocated standby 0.18 kg CO₂e.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Infrastructure</td><td>Allocated gate materials</td><td>1/10,000 of reusable gate material inventory</td><td>5.49 kg CO₂e</td><td>Approved factor ledger: concrete 118.80 kg CO₂e/t; glass/crystal proxy 1,402.77; aluminium proxy 9,113.58; steel proxy 2,861.58. Component masses are not separately reported in the approved carousel.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Maintenance</td><td>HGV freight</td><td>3.5 t × 85 km allocated across 100 activations = 2.975 t·km / activation</td><td>0.31 kg CO₂e</td><td>DEFRA 2026 average non-refrigerated HGV diesel freight factor: 0.10356 kg CO₂e/t·km.</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table></div>
      <div class="model-notes">
        <div class="stat-card"><h3>Included</h3><p>Gate activation electricity, red fire-guard energy, control and cooling, allocated gate materials and maintenance logistics.</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><h3>Excluded</h3><p>Realm creation, divine labour, traveller biology, avoided travel, Ragnarok collapse and magic distance.</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><h3>Cut-off</h3><p>Minor flows below the expected 1% contribution threshold are declared and excluded when no representative factor exists.</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><h3>Evidence status</h3><p>DEFRA 2026 factors are documented; myth and visible-light framing provide literature context; dimensions, mass, power and duration are engineering assumptions; the red fire-guard is a narrative proxy.</p></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section hotspot-visual-section">
      <div class="section-heading visual-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">HOTSPOT</p><h2>The bridge is an electricity story.</h2></div><p class="section-note">Electricity accounts for 95.2% of the approved baseline. The red fire-guard alone contributes 73.7 kg CO₂e.</p></div>
      <figure class="visual-panel visual-panel-feature"><img src="../assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-hotspot-breakdown.svg" alt="Bifrost hotspot breakdown showing electricity at 95.2 percent of the 120.3 kilogram carbon dioxide equivalent baseline and the red fire-guard as the largest single flow" loading="lazy" decoding="async"><figcaption>Hotspot breakdown · contribution to the 120.3 kg CO₂e baseline</figcaption></figure>
    </section>

    <section id="results" class="section episode-summary">
      <div class="fact-card"><h3>Main result</h3><p><strong>120.3 kg CO₂e</strong><br>Per controlled 10-minute activation.</p></div>
      <div class="fact-card"><h3>Electricity</h3><p><strong>95.2%</strong><br>The dominant life-cycle contribution.</p></div>
      <div class="fact-card"><h3>Red fire-guard</h3><p><strong>73.7 kg CO₂e</strong><br>The largest single modeled flow.</p></div>
      <div class="fact-card"><h3>Allocated materials</h3><p><strong>4.6%</strong><br>Gate infrastructure becomes secondary after 10,000-activation amortization.</p></div>
    </section>

    <section class="section status-grid">
      <div class="stat-card"><h3>Physical sensitivity</h3><p><strong>Lower light intensity → 101.8 kg CO₂e</strong><br><strong>Baseline → 120.3 kg CO₂e</strong><br><strong>Higher light intensity → 157.2 kg CO₂e</strong><br><strong>Cooler red strand → 83.4 kg CO₂e</strong><br><strong>Hotter red strand → 194.0 kg CO₂e</strong><br>The approved baseline lock is 120.28 kg CO₂e. The red strand is the physical uncertainty that matters most.</p></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><h3>Data sensitivity</h3><p><strong>Shorter design life → 125.8 kg CO₂e</strong><br><strong>Higher grid factor → 177.5 kg CO₂e</strong><br><strong>Low-carbon supply → 28.7 kg CO₂e</strong><br>Shortening the gate life to 5,000 activations changes little. Electricity carbon intensity is the stronger data lever.</p></div>
    </section>

    <section class="section status-grid">
      <div class="stat-card"><h3>What the model tells us</h3><p>A reusable bridge is not necessarily a material story. Once infrastructure is amortized, each crossing is dominated by the energy needed to stabilize light, maintain the fire-guard and operate the gates.</p></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><h3>Boundary interpretation</h3><p>Realm creation and avoided travel are excluded rather than converted into speculative credits or hidden burdens. The result describes one controlled physical activation only.</p></div>
    </section>

    <section class="section verdict">
      <p class="eyebrow">THE VERDICT</p>
      <blockquote>The bridge is not weightless; its burden is operational.</blockquote>
    </section>

def verify_cover():
    cover = ROOT / COVER_REL
    if not cover.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f'Approved cover missing: {COVER_REL}')
    digest = hashlib.sha256(cover.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if digest != COVER_SHA256:
        raise SystemExit(f'Cover SHA-256 mismatch: {digest}')
    with Image.open(cover) as im:
        if im.size != (1122, 1402):
            raise SystemExit(f'Cover dimensions mismatch: {im.size}')
        if im.format != 'PNG':
            raise SystemExit(f'Cover format mismatch: {im.format}')


def write_text(rel, text):
    path = ROOT / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')


def update_registry():
    path = ROOT / 'episodes.json'
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    data['schemaVersion'] = 2
    eps = [e for e in data.get('episodes', []) if int(e.get('number', -1)) != 50]
    eps.append(EPISODE)
    eps.sort(key=lambda e: int(e['number']), reverse=True)
    data['episodes'] = eps
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')), encoding='utf-8')


def update_collections():
    path = ROOT / 'collections.json'
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    found = False
    for collection in data.get('collections', []):
        nums = [int(n) for n in collection.get('episodes', []) if int(n) != 50]
        if collection.get('slug') == 'legendary-engineering':
            nums.append(50)
            nums = sorted(set(nums), reverse=True)
            found = True
        collection['episodes'] = nums
    if not found:
        raise SystemExit('legendary-engineering collection missing')
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')


def main():
    verify_cover()
    write_text('assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-inventory-map.svg', INVENTORY_MAP)
    write_text('assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-technical-plate.svg', TECHNICAL_PLATE)
    write_text('assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-hotspot-breakdown.svg', HOTSPOT)
    write_text('episodes/bifrost.html', HTML)
    update_registry()
    update_collections()
    print('Episode 50 publication source files generated successfully.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
